recognize_zh: 血片中數顆中型淋巴細胞，核圓形居中、染色質中度濃縮，細胞質淡藍中量並有不規則小突起，符合毛細胞白血病變異型的腫瘤細胞；背景紅血球變形明顯（棘狀、碎片、橢圓形）。
features: Intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round, centrally placed nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved at this magnification
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with irregular, short cytoplasmic projections
Background marked poikilocytosis with echinocytes, elliptocytes and fragmented red cells
Occasional small mature lymphocytes and a granulocyte for comparison; platelets appear reduced
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell poikilocytosis including echinocytes, elliptocytes and fragments, with apparently reduced platelets. Several intermediate-sized atypical lymphoid cells are present, with round central nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm bearing irregular short projections. Nucleolar detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with circulating neoplastic cells of hairy cell leukemia variant in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD11c+, CD103+, CD25-, annexin A1-).

ddx.vs: Classic HCL is usually leukopenic with monocytopenia, has bean-shaped nuclei without prominent nucleoli, and is CD25/CD123/annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positive.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar short villi, more condensed chromatin and are CD103 negative.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based villous projections without nucleoli and express cyclin D3, with overlap requiring integration of phenotype and genetics.
Prolymphocytes have a single prominent nucleolus and lack cytoplasmic projections.
